exposure: Welch Allyn SureTemp® Plus oral thermometer
outcome: Agreement between different temperature monitors (Dräger T-core© vs. Welch Allyn SureTemp® Plus oral thermometer vs. Braun 3-in-1 No Touch infrared thermometer)
cohort: 166 women undergoing elective or emergency caesarean deliveries
finding: The study found poor agreement between a noninvasive core temperature monitor and two readily available peripheral temperature monitors in detecting thermoregulatory changes during obstetric spinal anaesthesia.
